title: ci: cache npm dependencies to speed up tests
hint: A CI speed-up that turns into a “pwn request”
description: Turns on npm caching in `actions/setup-node` so CI stops reinstalling every dependency on each run. Cuts the test job from ~4 min to ~2 min.

planted.label: Runs fork PRs with a privileged trigger
Checks out untrusted PR code in that privileged context
Exposes the npm publish token to PR code
